issue_context.title: Generic Camera integration's RTSP camera streams (from Dahua XVR) no longer work after upgrade to 2023.4.5
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Dahua DVR's and XVR's (as well as other companies' similar products that are rebadged Dahuas or Hickvision or use the same chipsets - which covers a large % of the market) make analog (CVBS, HD-CVI, AHD, etc) cameras' streams which they receive & digitze, transcoded to MP4 and such, and available on the network.

In the Dahua's case, the format of such streams is, for video:
rtsp://[XVR's IP]:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=[Channel#]&subtype=1&unicast=true&proto=Onvif
... and for stills:
https://[XVR's IP]/onvifsnapshot/media_service/snapshot?channel=12&subtype=0

After the upgrade to 2023.4.5, this no longer works for such analog cameras' streams from the DVR's and XVR's. The camera windows are gray with a broken icon in the middle. The natively IP cameras, however, using the same exact integration, are working just fine. There are errors in the log (see below).

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.4.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

 2023.2

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Generic Camera

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/generic/

_No response_

_No response_

Can confirm similar behavior with stills using a Dahua Color-4k-X camera.

These URLs work via Chrome after providing basic-auth credentials: 
http://[Camera IP]/cgi-bin/snapshot.cgi
http://[Camera IP]/onvifsnapshot/media_service/snapshot?channel=1&subtype=0

They do not work within the integration using either inline credentials or populating the basic auth form items.  
I have the "verify SSL certificate" unchecked & am only attempting http connections; the camera doesn't have any sort of certs/ssl enabled.

Omitting the Still Image URL and using the RTSP-stream only works, although the "preview" during configuration comes up blank.  When adding the entity to a dashboard, however, it does render a still image refreshed every 10 seconds.   

Viewing the live RTSP stream, however, only works smoothly when using the lower-resolution substream 1. 
this particular camera has 2 substreams.  
Stream 1 is H.264H at 704x480 @ 10FPS.  
Stream 2 is H.265 at 1280x720 @ 10FPS


FWIW, my local connection to HA is secure using a local domain-generated certificate.   Given Chef's error above, it sounds SSL / TLS related.

It’s likely openssl3 changes.

probably needs to explicitly allow older ssl versions and turn off some security flags to work
